method: 20 priority customer questions selected through English/Arabic search-result research and a full-text audit of 27 existing bilingual topics. Editorial priority, not a claim of measured keyword-volume rank.
rules: Write complete professional English and natural Modern Standard Arabic, with equivalent facts in both versions.

Each article: direct answer, original practical depth, at least one meaningful table, one useful visual, four customer Q&A pairs, at least three relevant internal links and two primary external references.

Use only verified owner-approved commercial facts. Do not invent inclusions, transport charges, tax treatment, hours for long plans, notice periods, guarantees, trial availability, approval times, certificates, ranking results or search volumes.

Do not put 'unconfirmed', 'not confirmed', 'غير مؤكد' or editorial uncertainty notes in customer-facing copy. Omit unsupported claims; explain concrete actions, responsibilities and the documented agreement positively.
Practical schedules and workflows are original planning examples, not promised completion times or formal government requirements.

Residence visas and work permission are separate. Agency service cancellation is separate from worker employment/permit/residence cancellation. Keep recruitment-fee statutory refunds separate from monthly-service commercial refunds.
Respect worker rest, privacy and lawful scope; do not equate nationality with skill, residence with 24-hour work, housekeeping with licensed healthcare, or a planning schedule with an unpaid trial.
Use prices only where they answer the question, rather than repeating the six-price table in every article.
